Vt.bar_b_note: A warm, readable elder villager whose palette sits in the key art's world carries it; the flat black bead eyes and neutral grey stage are all that hold it back.

Eo.bar_b_note: A's blue-grey panel is on direction, but the world behind it is a murky, dark mid-tone with no sky or light grade, and B's tiny truncated text and corner hints are below a shipping HUD.

Lf.bar_b_note: The same appealing elder villager as Vt, with a clear silhouette and a natural palette; only the doll-like solid black eyes keep it from the Palworld-level finish.

Kg.bar_b_note: Sunk by a murky brown mid-tone forest with no purple storm sky or lightning, flat magenta ground rings as telegraphs, a heavy HUD, an invisible player creature, and in B camera-in-foliage blackouts (i11-i15).

Bs.bar_b_note: Both wolves read as a Palworld-class creature, and A's fur and violet veins match the owner's Tanglevolt bar, but the faint poses break (A floats in faint mid; B's faint end tips nose-down).

Gc.bar_b_note: The stocky smith's silhouette and warm palette fit the world, but the soft, low-resolution painted face with slit eyes reads below shipping finish in close-up.

top_changes.change: Kg/Stormwood combat: keep the camera out of trunks and canopy (fade occluders), lift the fight off the murky brown with the purple storm sky, rim light and white-violet lightning, mark the player's creature clearly, slim the HUD, and replace the flat magenta ground rings with physical telegraphs (cracking earth, sparks, stones) that end in a visible impact

Craft panel: keep A's large layout but wrap recipe cost lines at a larger size with higher contrast than the salmon text, keep the full recipe list visible, and use controller-first button glyphs next to the Craft/Leave hints

Characters and creatures: grounded faint and hit animations (no mid-air bodies or nose-down tips) and higher-resolution faces with lit, readable eyes for villagers (Gc's face texture, Vt/Lf's bead eyes)
